UPDATE (2020)
I had completely forgotten I left a review on here so I figured it’s time for an update. I was really heart broken when me and my ex had broken up so I tried looking for answers to see if I’d end up back with him (which is what I wanted at the time). I had spoken to 3 psychic advisors and even spent money on this app (which I never do). I was just trying to look for answers when I was in a dark place after a break up with someone I loved dearly. I remember them telling me that I’d be back with him in around “3 months time”. At that point my hopes went waaaaay up and I was really happy. I couldn’t wait. It turned out to be a complete let down. Time passed and nothing ever happened, we never ended up back together in fact he ended up committing suicide (I know this might sound made up but I swear its not.) It took me a long time to heal from everything. Especially with me having my hopes up and trusting these people blindly. I should have just myself go through the hurt of a breakup on my own and not try to get someone to tell me what I want to hear (that we’d end up back together). 

Anyway, I’m in such a better place now. 

*** Please don’t download this app and trust them. It’s definitely a scam. I just don’t want anyone getting their hopes up or wasting their money to be let down like I was. I honestly believe most of the reviews on here are fake. The ones with low ratings are the real deal, believe me. 👐🏼 

Or they guessed and got it right and the person was amazed lol and left a good review.
